web_listen_address.description: Network address (host:port) on which to expose the Prometheus metrics endpoint.

mail_servers.description: List of IMAP servers to monitor. Each entry defines a server connection.

label.description: Human-readable name for this server (used in comments and metric labels).

connection_string.description: IMAP server connection string in the format scheme://user:password@host:port. Use 'imaps' for SSL/TLS, 'imap' for plain/STARTTLS.

check_interval.description: How often to poll mail servers for new messages. Accepts Go duration strings (e.g., '30s', '1m').

timeout.description: Maximum time allowed per IMAP connection/check before timing out.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of recent messages to fetch per mailbox. Set to 0 for unlimited.

skip_tls_verify.description: If true, skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to IMAP servers (not recommended for production).

starttls.description: If true, attempt to upgrade plain connections using STARTTLS (use only when connecting to port 143).

imap_flags.description: IMAP flags to track as separate metrics (e.g., count of flagged or unseen messages).

web_basic_auth_user.description: Optional username for HTTP Basic Auth protecting the metrics endpoint.

web_basic_auth_password.description: Optional password for HTTP Basic Auth protecting the metrics endpoint.

metric_prefix.description: Prefix for all exported metric names (e.g., 'mailexporter_imap_messages_unseen').
